summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Pedrola, a municipality in Spain. It places the municipality in the province of Zaragoza in Aragon and gives its population from the 2004 INE census.
one_line: Pedrola is a municipality in the province of Zaragoza, Aragon, Spain, with 2,906 inhabitants in the 2004 census.
key_facts: Pedrola is a municipality located in the province of Zaragoza.
Pedrola is located in Aragon, Spain.
According to the 2004 census (INE), the municipality of Pedrola has a population of 2,906 inhabitants.
